---
title: "Datasets"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

Every dataset shipped by candidate- and catalogued-tier packages, with
row and variable counts and direct download links to the CSV and XLSX
exports for non-R users.

```{r}
library(owdata)

DT::datatable(
  owd_datasets(),
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(pageLength = 25)
)
```
